title: Knowledge Base Metadata
description: Structure for the `Metadata` (JSON text) property on the Notion "📚 Knowledge Base" database. Applies to every Content Type (Professional Experience, Academic Experience, Personal Interest, Project, Skill); every field is optional — fill in only what's relevant to a given entry. Stored as a JSON string in Notion, parsed at ingestion/build time.

category.description: Display grouping for CV/Portfolio UI, e.g. "Web App", "Full-time Role", "Certification", "Hobby".

end.description: ISO 8601 date. Omit if `ongoing` is true.

location.description: Free text, e.g. "Remote" or "Mexico City, MX".

links.description: External links related to this entry.

media.description: Images/video for the Portfolio card and detail page.

alt.description: Accessibility alt text (required in practice for images).

cover.description: Marks this item as the card/thumbnail image. At most one item per entry should be true.

techStack.description: Freeform technology list, kept separate from the fixed `Tags` multi-select.

originalFile.description: Legacy field — path/reference to a source document if this entry was migrated from a file rather than authored directly in Notion.
